LanguageData.PhobosFactory_NoBillsAvailable: No bills yet: each one appears once its bench recipe is unlocked (research, or a mod's own unlock such as Rimatomics research).
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_BeltsMayTakeDesc:
When on, conveyor belts and factory machines take from this storage as they do from a factory hopper.

A belt next to this storage that points straight away from it takes one whole stack at a time whenever it has room, whatever the belt's filter says. Belts that only run past it leave it alone. A factory machine takes ingredients from it when it stands on one of the machine's input cells.

Everything stored here can go, so switch it on only for storage that should feed the factory. Off for new storage.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_BeltsMayTakeOn: Belts and factory machines may now take from the selected storage.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_BeltsMayTakeOff: Belts and factory machines no longer take from the selected storage.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_SettingWaterRequiredDesc: On: some bills, such as soup and mass-produced meals on the conveyor oven, draw water from your plumbing and pause while there is none. Off: they need no water. Takes effect at once. Dubs Bad Hygiene's lite mode has no plumbing, so bills need no water there either way.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_SettingDirtyWaterPoisonsDe: On: food cooked with water from a contaminated water tower may give whoever eats it food poisoning. Off: water quality makes no difference to food. Takes effect at once, but food already poisoned stays poisoned.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterNoPlumbing: No water: run plumbing with a water tower under this machine or against its side.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterTowersEmpty: No water: the water towers on this machine's plumbing are empty.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterNeeded: Needs {LITRES} L of piped water a batch.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterUntreated: Water: {LITRES} L a batch, untreated. Cooking makes it safe.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterUntreatedRisk: Water: {LITRES} L a batch, untreated. A batch made with it has a {CHANCE} chance of carrying food poisoning.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterContaminatedRisk: Water: {LITRES} L a batch, contaminated! A batch made with it has a {CHANCE} chance of carrying food poisoning.
LanguageData.PhobosFactory_WaterBillNote: Needs {LITRES} L of piped water a batch, unless you switch that off in this mod's options.
